- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant indicated that the tool can help users plan and manage projects more efficiently by breaking down tasks into manageable steps and tracking progress (Project management).

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant showcased that the tool can be utilized in business planning, including product development, marketing, and sales strategies (Business planning).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant illustrated that the tool can help users set and achieve personal goals by providing a clear visual representation of the steps necessary to reach them (Personal goal setting).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant demonstrated that the tool can assist users in taking more effective notes by organizing information in a more visual and memorable format (Note-taking).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant highlighted that the tool can foster teamwork and collaboration by allowing multiple users to contribute and share their ideas on a single mind map (Collaboration and team building).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant illustrated that the tool can help users prepare and deliver presentations more effectively by creating visual aids and improving organization and delivery (Presentations and public speaking).
